lines.en: label sportswars4:
scene sportstrivia1
: Before our next contest begins, I’d like to ask for a moment of silence in remembrance of our dearly departed Sana.
lines.zh: : 在下一场比赛开始之前，我想请大家默哀片刻，悼念我们亲爱的、已经离世的 Sana。

lines.en: : May her soul find peace in this cruel, dark world.
lines.zh: : 愿她的灵魂在这个残酷而黑暗的世界里安息。

lines.en: : You two do know she’s still alive, right?
lines.zh: : 你们俩知道她还活着吧？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia2
: She’s just...{i}eggier{/i} than normal now.
lines.zh: : 她只是……比平时更「{i}蛋{/i}」了一点。

lines.en: : Uta, would you mind explaining again why {i}I{/i} was elected to compete in this contest instead of Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Uta，你能不能再解释一遍，为什么是{i}我{/i}被选来参加这个项目，而不是 Nodoka？

lines.en: : Because we’ve already had a Nodoka vs Makoto trivia battle and we all know how that went last time.
lines.zh: : 因为我们已经有过一场 Nodoka 对 Makoto 的知识对决了，而上次的结局大家也都知道。

lines.en: : But...we {i}won{/i} last time. Shouldn’t that be a thing we’re trying to, you know, {i}repeat?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是……上次是我们{i}赢了{/i}啊。那不正是我们应该……嗯，想办法{i}重现{/i}一次的吗？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia3

: Yes, Io. {i}But at what cost?{/i} If Makoto dies from embarrassment after being decimated a second time, Imani will just have to work harder to get all of our worksheets out and we can’t do that to her.
lines.zh: : 没错，Io。{i}但代价呢{/i}？如果 Makoto 因为第二次被碾得体无完肤而羞愤致死，Imani 就得一个人更辛苦地批改我们所有的作业，我们不能这么对她。

lines.en: : It’s good to know that I’m just as much of a priority as ever.
lines.zh: : 很高兴知道我在你们心里的优先级还是一如既往。

lines.en: : Uta’s obviously kidding, Makoto. Nobody actually wants you to die. Io was probably just chosen {i}now{/i} because this event requires minimal participation and she’s actually still {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : Uta 显然是在开玩笑啦，Makoto。没人真的想让你死。之所以{i}现在{/i}挑中 Io，大概只是因为这个项目对参与度要求最低，而她恰好还在{i}这儿{/i}。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter to me who I compete against. First and foremost, I just want to redeem myself for my prior performance. And Io being my opponent just means I’ll have an easier time doing that.
lines.zh: : 对手是谁我无所谓。首先，我只想为之前的表现挽回颜面。而对手是 Io，只不过意味着我更容易做到这一点。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia4
: Just because I don’t {i}want{/i} to do this doesn’t mean I’m going to be {i}bad{/i} at it. I take studying pretty seriously, you know.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}想{/i}参加，不代表我就会表现得{i}很差{/i}。我念书可是很认真的，好吗。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} know. I help Miss Imai grade the homework when I have spare time and you’re consistently better than almost everyone else in class.
lines.zh: : 我{i}知道{/i}。我有空的时候会帮 Imai 老师批改作业，你的成绩一直比班上几乎所有人都好。

lines.en: : Then what’s with the “Oh, it’ll be easier for me if it’s Io” stuff? You can’t just compliment me and insult me at the same time. Especially when my brain can’t process compliments in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那「对手是 Io 会更容易」那套话是什么意思？你不能一边夸我一边损我。尤其是我脑子本来就处理不了夸奖。

lines.en: : I just mean that you’ll be an easier opponent than Nodoka. And I’m pretty sure everyone here would agree with that.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，你比 Nodoka 好对付。而且我敢说在场的各位都会同意。

lines.en: : Nodoka {i}is{/i} rather...unfair to compete with in competitions like this.
lines.zh: : 在这种比赛里和 Nodoka 竞争，{i}是{/i}相当……不公平的。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia5

: Miss Imai, why do we even {i}have{/i} a competition like this in the first place? This has nothing to do with sports. Can we just end it in a tie and still earn our participation points so I can leave?
lines.zh: : Imai 老师，我们到底为什么要{i}搞{/i}这种比赛？这跟体育一点关系都没有。能不能直接算平局、照样拿参与分，好让我走人？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia6
: Didn’t Rika go over that in the preamble? I threw in a few mental contests since some of you see physical activity as a weak point.
lines.zh: : Rika 开场的时候不是讲过吗？我加了几个脑力项目，因为你们有些人把体育活动当成弱项。

lines.en: : Granted, you weren’t one of the girls I had in mind when I decided to do that, but your floormates have made this bed and now you must lie in it.
lines.zh: : 诚然，我当初决定这么做的时候，心里想的并不是你，但你们同楼的人自己铺的床，就得自己躺上去。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be fine, Io. Makoto’s really smart, but Rika’s really great at trivia too and Rika is...well, Rika is Rika.
lines.zh: : 你肯定没问题的，Io。Makoto 很聪明，可 Rika 也特别擅长冷知识竞答，而 Rika 嘛……Rika 就是 Rika。

lines.en: : Who the fuck is Rika?
lines.zh: : Rika 到底是他妈谁啊？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia7
: Woah, when the hell did {i}you{/i} get here?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，{i}你{/i}到底是啥时候来的？

lines.en: : A few minutes after the cyclops died and I’m already bored as shit.
lines.zh: : 独眼巨人死掉几分钟后我就到了，现在已经无聊得要命。

lines.en: : Yumi! Welcome to the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB! You didn’t see Maya anywhere on the way, did you? Because she kind of vanished out of nowhere and we {i}sort of{/i} need her here.
lines.zh: : Yumi！欢迎来到 SMUS-DDW：NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB！路上你没在别的地方看到 Maya 吧？因为她不知怎么就人间蒸发了，而我们这边{i}还挺{/i}需要她的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I wouldn’t count on that. Saw her decked out in her school uniform like ten minutes before I got here. Doubt she’s coming back.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我劝你别指望了。我来之前大概十分钟，看见她穿着整整齐齐的校服。我看她是不会回来了。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia8
: Oh, she better have a damn good excuse for this.
lines.zh: : 哦，她最好能拿出个像样的理由来。

lines.en: : Mwahahah! Between Maya’s disappearance and the fact that the second floor is already off to a commanding lead, you must be shaking in your gym shoes right now!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈！一边是 Maya 失踪，一边是二楼已经取得压倒性领先，你现在肯定在体操鞋里发抖吧！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia9
: There’s been one competition. You have one point.
lines.zh: : 这才比了一场。你们才一分。

lines.en: : Yes, but if there’s anything I know about percentages, it’s that {i}that{/i} is 100%% more than you guys have.
lines.zh: : 是没错，但要说我对百分比还有点了解的话，那就是{i}这{/i}比你们多出了 100%。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia10
: That...is not how percentages work.
lines.zh: : 这……不是百分比的算法。

lines.en: : Wait, it’s not?
lines.zh: : 等等，不是吗？

lines.en: : Leave her alone. She’s trying.
lines.zh: : 别为难她了。她已经很努力了。

lines.en: : No, I think Uta’s actually right, guys — 0 plus 100%% is 1, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得 Uta 其实是对的——0 加上 100% 就是 1，不是吗？

lines.en: : Her too.
lines.zh: : 她也别说了。

lines.en: : How is this school still operational when no one has learned anything at {i}any{/i} point here?
lines.zh: : 这儿从来没人学到过{i}任何{/i}东西，这学校到底是怎么开下去的？

lines.en: : I used to ask myself that same question every morning before I resigned myself to the fact that we’re never going to escape from this school year to begin with and-
lines.zh: : 我以前每天早上都会问自己同样的问题，直到我认命地接受了一个事实——我们压根儿就逃不出这个学年，然后——

lines.en: scene sportstrivia11
: Blah, blah, blah — let’s get this show on the road, shall we?
lines.zh: : 巴拉巴拉——咱们赶紧把这场戏开演吧，好吗？

lines.en: : Do you think we should let Good Kid in? I feel kind of bad watching them play outside of the window. They look hungry.
lines.zh: : 我们要不要放 Good Kid 进来？看着他们在窗外演奏，我有点过意不去。他们看起来饿坏了。

lines.en: : They’ve been trapped inside of Kumon-mi for years now! I’m sure they won’t mind being trapped outside of the school for a little longer. Besides, we’ve got bigger fish to fry!
lines.zh: : 他们都被困在 Kumon-mi 好几年了！我敢肯定，再被关在校门外一会儿他们也不会介意。再说了，我们还有更要紧的事要办呢！

lines.en: : Io! Makoto! This year’s contest will work just like the last one we did- but with one caveat! You get to choose the category your opponent answers a question from!
lines.zh: : Io！Makoto！今年的比赛规则和上次一样——不过有一点不同！你们可以指定对手要回答的问题类别！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia12
: You’ll answer questions one-by-one until someone reaches ten points.
lines.zh: : 你们轮流作答，直到有人拿到十分为止。

lines.en: : And if you both reach ten points in the same amount of turns, we’ll have sudden death rounds until one of you answers correctly and one of you doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 如果你们在相同的回合数内同时达到十分，就进入突然死亡加时赛，直到一人答对、一人答错为止。

lines.en: : Now, tell ‘em what they’ll win if they make it through the whole contest without getting a single question wrong!
lines.zh: : 现在，告诉她们——如果全程一题都不错，她们能赢到什么！

lines.en: : Nothing. There is no bonus for that and I don’t know why Uta alluded to there being one in the first place.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有。这没有额外奖励，我也不知道 Uta 一开始为什么要暗示有。

lines.en: : Gotta keep ‘em on their toes, Chika. You pick up tricks like this when you’ve been a contest host for as long as me.
lines.zh: : 得让她们时刻保持紧张嘛，Chika。你像我一样当了这么久的比赛主持人，自然就会这些小把戏。

lines.en: : Well, Miss {i}Host,{/i} do you think you can maybe pick up the pace a little? Because we’ve got the obstacle course after this and I’m going to need a little more help setting stuff up for that.
lines.zh: : 那么，{i}主持人{/i}小姐，能不能请你稍微加快点节奏？因为这场之后就是障碍赛了，我还得多找人帮忙布置场地呢。

lines.en: : Roger that, Imani! And since losers always go first, we’ll let Makoto choose Io’s first subject to kick things off!
lines.zh: : 收到，Imani！既然输家总是先来，那就让 Makoto 先选 Io 的第一个科目，正式开始！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia13
: Bioengineering.
lines.zh: : 生物工程。

lines.en: : What?! Isn’t that a little too specific?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！这也太刁钻了吧？！

lines.en: : The heck even is that? That ain’t a thing we learn in school. I thought we were sticking to school subjects?
lines.zh: : 那到底是个什么鬼？学校里根本没教过啊。我们不是说好只考学校科目吗？

lines.en: : Imani, are advanced topics off limits? Or can we ask Io some kind of...bioengineering question?
lines.zh: : Imani，高深的话题算不算犯规？还是说我们可以问 Io 某种……生物工程的问题？

lines.en: : I’ll allow it! Ask away, girls! Let’s put Io’s bioengineering knowledge to the test!
lines.zh: : 我批准了！尽管问吧，姑娘们！让我们来检验一下 Io 的生物工程知识！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia14
: I don’t have any!
lines.zh: : 我一点都没有！

lines.en: : I do. But of course I’m missing out on one more opportunity to show everyone how brilliant I am.
lines.zh: : 我有。不过我当然又错过了一个向大家展示我有多聪明绝顶的机会。

lines.en: : Just give me the loss already! This is ridiculous!
lines.zh: : 直接判我输吧！这太荒唐了！

lines.en: : How the heck do you even spell-
lines.zh: : 这到底该怎么拼——

lines.en: : Here! I found a question.
lines.zh: : 有了！我找到一道题。

lines.en: : Io, the use of living systems and organisms to develop products is known as what?
lines.zh: : Io，利用生物系统和生物体来开发产品，这被称为什么？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia15
: Is...Is it not just bioengineering?
lines.zh: : 难道……不就是生物工程吗？

lines.en: : Crap! How’d she know that?!
lines.zh: : 糟了！她怎么会知道？！

lines.en: : She didn’t. It’s bio{i}technology.{/i} It involves the application of biological knowledge and techniques to various fields such as agriculture, medicine, and industry.
lines.zh: : 她没答对。是生物{i}技术{/i}。指的是把生物学知识与技术应用到农业、医学、工业等各个领域。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what I meant.
lines.zh: : 对，我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Bzzt! Answer not accepted.
lines.zh: : 哔——！回答不成立。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia16
: Phew! Had me goin’ there for a second. Thought Io actually knew that one.
lines.zh: : 呼！刚才还真吓了我一跳。我还以为 Io 真知道呢。

lines.en: : Yeah well, sorry to be a disappointment, but I’m kind of a disappointment.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉让你失望了，不过我本来就是个让人失望的人。

lines.en: : That was a fair guess, though. It definitely could have been a trick question with the way it was worded.
lines.zh: : 不过这猜得挺合理的。就那措辞而言，完全有可能是道陷阱题。

lines.en: : Don’t dwell on it, Io! Just choose a topic Makoto won’t know about and get back at her the good old fashioned way!
lines.zh: : 别纠结了，Io！挑一个 Makoto 不懂的科目，用最传统的方式扳回一局！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia17
: I’ll take “being tolerable” for 500, Alex.
lines.zh: : 我要选「还算好相处」，500 分，Alex。

lines.en: : You got this, Makoto! You’re super great at bein’ tolerable!
lines.zh: : 你可以的，Makoto！你「还算好相处」这方面可厉害了！

lines.en: : Io, come on. Choose a real subject.
lines.zh: : Io，别闹了。选个正经科目。

lines.en: : Fine. Sports.
lines.zh: : 行吧。体育。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia18
: Shit.
lines.zh: : 糟了。

lines.en: : Makoto! To take the lead, who is the all-time home run leader in the NPB?!
lines.zh: : Makoto！为了拿下领先，请说出 NPB（日本职棒）历史上的本垒打王是谁？！

lines.en: : Well, that’s...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是……

lines.en: : Just pass, Makoto. You ain’t gotta know everything.
lines.zh: : 直接过吧，Makoto。你没必要什么都知道。

lines.en: : No, I...uhh...
: Shohei Ohtani?...
lines.zh: : Shohei Ohtani？……

lines.en: scene sportstrivia19
: Ohtani?!?! Are you even Japanese?! That’s light years worse than my answer!
lines.zh: : Ohtani？！？！你到底是不是日本人啊？！这比我的答案还离谱一万倍！

lines.en: : I don’t watch baseball. How was I ever supposed to know that?
lines.zh: : 我又没在看棒球。我怎么会知道啊？

lines.en: : Ohtani only played in the NPB for five seasons! He would have had to hit over 170 home runs every single year to break Sadaharu Oh’s record of 868!
lines.zh: : Ohtani 在日本职棒只打了五个赛季！要想打破 Sadaharu Oh 的 868 支纪录，他得每年打出 170 多支本垒打才行！

lines.en: : Is that...Is that a lot?
lines.zh: : 那……那算多吗？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia20
: Can I leave now?! I can’t be around these people anymore!
lines.zh: : 我现在能走了吗？！我再也受不了跟这些人待在一起了！

lines.en: : I like Ohtani...he seems like a good boy...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢 Ohtani……他看起来是个好孩子……

lines.en: scene sportstrivia21
: He is! But that doesn’t change the fact that he’s not even in the top 100 for home runs in the NPB! He only had 48!
lines.zh: : 他确实是！可这也改变不了他在日本职棒本垒打榜上连前一百都进不了的事实！他只有 48 支！

lines.en: : Yasu, you’re...aware of the existence of Shohei Ohtani?
lines.zh: : Yasu，你……居然知道 Shohei Ohtani 这个人？

lines.en: : Of course. I’m Japanese.
lines.zh: : 当然。我是日本人。

lines.en: : See?! Even {i}Yasu{/i} knows and she’s {i}Yasu!{/i}
lines.zh: : 看吧？！连 {i}Yasu{/i} 都知道，而她可是 {i}Yasu{/i} 啊！

lines.en: : Ohtani could get it.
lines.zh: : Ohtani 的话，我可以。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia22
: Miss Imai!
lines.zh: : Imai 老师！

lines.en: : What? Is that really a controversial thing to say? Look at him. He’s adorable. And those arms? Sheesh.
lines.zh: : 怎么？这话很有争议吗？看看他。多可爱啊。还有那双臂膀？啧啧。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Ohtani could get it.
lines.zh: : Ohtani 的话，我可以。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia23
: I rest my case.
lines.zh: : 无需多言。

lines.en: : Yumi!
lines.zh: : Yumi！

lines.en: : I mean...he’s kind of the perfect guy, isn’t he? Like, could I even call myself straight if I said no to him?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……他算是很完美的男人了吧？话说回来，要是拒绝了他，我还能自称是直女吗？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia24
: I have never been more proud than I am in this very moment.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有像此刻这么骄傲过。

lines.en: : Yeah...he sure is dreamy, isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 是啊……他确实很让人着迷，不是吗？

lines.en: : He’d be {i}dreamier{/i} if he hit another 820 home runs! Now, can we stop fawning over the guy and get on with this contest already?! The amount of estrogen here is suffocating me!
lines.zh: : 他要是再打 820 支本垒打，我会{i}更着迷{/i}！现在能不能别再对着这个男人犯花痴，赶紧把比赛比完？！这里的雌激素浓度快让我窒息了！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia25
: R-Right! Makoto! Choose Io’s next subject!
lines.zh: : 好……好的！Makoto！选 Io 的下一个科目！

lines.en: scene sportstrivia26
: Attack her where it hurts, Makoto! Hit her with “public speaking!”
lines.zh: : 攻她的痛处，Makoto！用「公开演讲」击垮她！

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 千万别。

lines.en: : How about...economics?
lines.zh: : 那……经济学怎么样？

lines.en: : That the fancy word for “public speaking?”
lines.zh: : 那是「公开演讲」的高级说法吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s the fancy word for “money stuff.” And fine. It’s not a strong suit, but it’s easier than bioengineering at least.
lines.zh: : 不，那是「钱那些事」的高级说法。行吧。这不是我的强项，但至少比生物工程简单。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that, Io.
lines.zh: : 那可不一定哦，Io。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia27
: {i}I bet I’ll know this one too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我打赌这道我也会。{/i}

lines.en: : Careful. Your ego’s showin’, Princess.
lines.zh: : 小心点。你的自负露出来了，公主殿下。

lines.en: : Io, please describe what the phrase “Paradox of Thrift” means.
lines.zh: : Io，请解释一下「节俭悖论」是什么意思。

lines.en: : Paradox of...Thrift?
lines.zh: : 节俭……悖论？

lines.en: : Isn’t that the idea where, like...if everyone starts saving their money, it will have negative effects on the economy? Since businesses need money in order to function and whatnot?
lines.zh: : 是不是说……如果所有人都开始存钱，反而会对经济产生负面影响？因为企业需要资金才能运转之类的？

lines.en: : Uhhhhh maybe? I haven’t read the answer yet but that sounds kind of-
lines.zh: : 呃……大概吧？我还没看答案，不过听起来有点——

lines.en: : Oh, shit.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia28
: Yeah, that’s...that’s basically what that means. Huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那……基本上就是这个意思。哦。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you actually knew that.
lines.zh: : 没想到你还真知道。

lines.en: : Can you be surprised in a way that doesn’t involve you making eye contact with me?
lines.zh: : 你能不能用一种不需要和我对视的方式来表达惊讶？

lines.en: : Probably. But that would defeat the purpose of trying to understand you better and leave you with no one to talk to but Uta.
lines.zh: : 大概可以。但那样一来，我就没法更好地了解你了，你也只剩 Uta 一个人可以说话。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly. That’s the whole point.
lines.zh: : 对，正是如此。我要的就是这个效果。

lines.en: : So you {i}want{/i} to be lonely?
lines.zh: : 所以你就是{i}想{/i}孤单一人？

lines.en: : Nah. She just {i}is{/i} lonely because she talks shit on everyone and everything for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 不。她只是因为无缘无故地贬低所有人和所有事，所以才{i}变得{/i}孤单。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia29
: I do apologize if I’m misunderstanding, but...is that not what you do as well?
lines.zh: : 如果我理解有误，我先道歉，不过……你不也是这样吗？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia30
scene sportstrivia31
: Yumi’s just misunderstood. Meanwhile, Io {i}wants{/i} everyone to dislike her.
lines.zh: : Yumi 只是被人误解了。而 Io 呢，是{i}希望{/i}所有人都讨厌她。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia32
: Hey. That’s...
lines.zh: : 喂。这话……

lines.en: : Why did you have to say that? Io didn’t do anything.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛非得说这个？Io 又没做什么。

lines.en: : She’s been complaining about being in the same room as all of us since the contest started. Are we not allowed to respond to that?
lines.zh: : 从比赛开始她就一直在抱怨跟我们待在同一个房间里。我们连回嘴都不行吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t {i}have{/i} to complain at all if everyone just left me alone.
lines.zh: : 要是所有人都别来烦我，我根本{i}用不着{/i}抱怨。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia33
: We literally do. Every day. Yet you {i}still{/i} look down on all of us. But I like your friend, so I’m going to leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 我们真的有。每天都这样。可你{i}依然{/i}瞧不起我们所有人。不过我喜欢你那位朋友，所以我只说到这儿。

lines.en: : Okay, that’s enough with the hostility for now. Can you guys get back to asking questions, or do we need to take a quick recess and remember that today is supposed to be {i}fun?{/i}
lines.zh: : 好了，敌意就到此为止吧。你们能继续答题了吗？还是说我们需要先中场休息一下，好记起今天本来应该是{i}开心{/i}的一天？

lines.en: scene sportstrivia34
: Maybe my idea of “fun” is just a little different from everyone else’s. But, personally, I don’t find anything enjoyable about being forced to participate in-
lines.zh: : 也许我对「有趣」的定义和大家不太一样。但就我个人而言，被逼着参加——我实在找不出任何乐趣。

lines.en: : Foreign language is another weak point of mine.
lines.zh: : 外语也是我的另一个弱项。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia35
: Huh?
: If you’re trying to stump me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你想难倒我的话。

lines.en: : You want to get out of here, don’t you? The fastest way to do that is either by winning or losing.
lines.zh: : 你想赶紧离开这儿，对吧？最快的方法无非是赢，或者输。

lines.en: : But just because I gave you a hint this time, don’t expect me to roll over and go down without a fight.
lines.zh: : 不过，就算这次我给了你提示，也别指望我会躺平认输、不战而降。

lines.en: : Even {i}if{/i} there’s no true prize this year, a competition is still a competition. And I’m not going to take it easy on you just because you have social anxiety.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}今年没有真正的奖品，比赛终究是比赛。我也不会因为你有社交焦虑就对你手下留情。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia36
: It’s way more than just {i}social anxiety,{/i} you know. And I’m not {i}asking{/i} you to take it easy on me. I don’t need your pity.
lines.zh: : 这可远远不只是{i}社交焦虑{/i}，好吗。而且我也没{i}求{/i}你手下留情。我不需要你的怜悯。

lines.en: : Well, that works out then. Because there are plenty of people I’d pity before you.
lines.zh: : 那正好。因为在怜悯你之前，我有一大把人可以先去同情。

lines.en: : The air within the room has changed.
lines.zh: : 房间里的空气变了。

lines.en: : I can hear the sounds of their hearts bouncing off of the walls. They plead to be embraced and long for the removal of the chains that bind them.
lines.zh: : 我能听见她们的心跳声在墙壁上回荡。它们乞求被拥抱，渴望挣脱束缚自己的锁链。

lines.en: : Do you...have a solution, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 你……有解决办法吗，Yasu？

lines.en: scene black
: She must ask her about “biology.”
lines.zh: : 她得问她一道「生物」题。

lines.en: {i}Fifteen minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}十五分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene sportstrivia37
: {i}Why?{/i} Why did I think listening to someone would actually be a good idea this time?
lines.zh: : {i}为什么{/i}？我为什么会觉得这次听别人的话会是个好主意？

lines.en: : It seemed like a good idea to me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那主意挺好的啊。

lines.en: scene sportstrivia38
: Yeah, because {i}you{/i} won. And now we’ve gotta figure out a way to take another lead before y’all wind up getting points deducted for Maya’s mysterious disappearance.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为{i}你{/i}赢了。现在我们还得想个办法再次领先，免得你们最后因为 Maya 神秘失踪而被扣分。

lines.en: : Final score — Makoto 10, Io 7. And with Imani officially overseeing the contest, the first floor will now receive their point, which ties the score of the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB at one point each.
lines.zh: : 最终比分——Makoto 10 分，Io 7 分。在 Imani 的正式监督下，一楼拿下这一分，使 SMUS-DDW：NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB 的总比分以 1 比 1 打成平手。

lines.en: : For now, at least...Maya isn’t answering her phone. And I’m starting to think she won’t be competing at all.
lines.zh: : 至少目前是这样……Maya 不接电话。我开始觉得她根本不会参赛了。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I said earlier. She ain’t comin’ back. I know “aimlessly wanderin’ around” when I see it.
lines.zh: : 我刚才就是这么说的。她不会回来了。「漫无目的地瞎晃」我一眼就看得出来。

lines.en: : Maybe she wasn’t feeling well? Or-
lines.zh: : 也许她身体不舒服？或者——

lines.en: : That’s exactly what it was.
lines.zh: : 就是这个原因。
